items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: musicians that has played with me. And, the phone numbers, I had my little book now. I doubt if any of them remember the phone numbers, you know, that, uh, I used to call him. Like Chester Jones. I know he wouldn't think of the number that I had, you know, old time number. Alvin Alcon. He was there.

ctx.x: Well, when they came to the coast they got to you, what was your age?

Mmm, I would say I was in my early parties when I came over here. One which I didn't know anyone, you know, to go play with. But, Cap, he would come get me. Sylvester, come get me. And, the guys heard about me on my little banjo. And, then I started playing with this one and that one. Then, I decided to get me a little band of my own. And, then I started at, uh, Miss Bernice, I'm Roman and Palmeyer. What was that? Miss Bernice, Roman and Palmeyer. I started playing there. They used to call it the Madame Priest…
What was his name? Trumpet. Trumpet. Mm-hmm.
